blurb: Nestled at the base of South Mountain in the heart of Ahwatukee, Ahwatukee Lakes Golf Club is more than just a golf course, it’s a gathering place for community, competition, and camaraderie. For decades, The Lakes has been a premier destination for golfers of all skill levels, offering a beautifully maintained layout that blends challenge, strategy, and stunning desert
